source.physicalMethod: All 1,816 previously native-route-complete, non-flying, <=60, non-raid V5 candidates are checked against 8-GU source OBJ floor samples and raw/corrected torso rays. Every sample must have walkable source support within 28.7 GU vertically and 6 GU laterally, all successive source-floor steps must be <=28.7 GU, and neither foot nor torso ray may hit source geometry. A single short steep stair riser is accepted only between walkable source surfaces separated by <=28.7 GU and <=16.1 GU XY. Other uncertain edges and all mob IDs using them are excluded. This is a conservative geometry screen, not client proof.
